description: Polyglot benchmark (rust/macros, Exercism, MIT): implement from instructions; the tests are hidden until the check.

steps.prompt: Solve the exercise in INSTRUCTIONS.md by implementing it in src/lib.rs, Cargo.toml. Use only the language's standard library. Hidden tests will check your solution against the instructions, so handle the edge cases they describe.

checks.name: hidden tests pass
checks.run: set -o pipefail; cp -a "$TASK_DIR/hidden/." . && cargo test --offline -q -- --include-ignored 2>&1 | tail -20
